notes: CONFLICT inside the entry: data block 'Cisterns: none' (recorded as C2 absence), but the entry quotes Guérin (1870) on two rock-hewn cisterns 'in the lower part of this hill, at the southern corner' (f1, S of the site). f2 is east of the support wall at the fort's SE corner (relative_to other). On Fig. 172 each 'Basin' is an irregular outline c. 3-7 m with a small inner circle under 1 m, so the basin size is unclear. No size in the text, so pool_def unclear.
